exposure: vascular insufficiency in the intervillous space
outcome: microstructural abnormalities within developing white matter and cerebral cortex
cohort: The study included 4 pregnant Rhesus macaques.
finding: Dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) and T2*-based measurements of blood oxygenation can noninvasively assess in vivo placental health to identify pregnancies affected by placental insufficiency and abnormal fetal neurodevelopment.
